372:t_010:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll find a way for the sake of everyone who believes in us!」

372:t_010:8.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Using $$トライダー$$ as a reference, I've made a program to improve the energy transfer circuits! I'm sending it now!」

372:t_010:10.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Don't lose, $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$!」

372:t_010:12.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Grandpa told me you were in Japan. $$大太$$, $$久作$$, and I are all doing our best too.」

372:t_011:0.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「$$勝平$$! The program is installed! Hit it with full power!」

372:t_012:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「Amazing! Its power efficiency is on a whole other level now!」

372:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's my Big Bro $$イチ$$! I'll finish it off!」

372:t_013:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wow! The $$ムーン・アタック$$ is stronger too!」

372:t_013:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「The moon lights the dark night... You've grown stronger, $$勝平$$.」

372:t_013:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... With so many people counting on me, I couldn't help it.」

372:t_014:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「And... I'm sorry I called you a bumbling president.」

372:t_014:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm sorry too! Let's do our best together, $$勝平$$!」

372:t_014:4.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't let your guard down, $$勝平$$. That mysterious robot army is here too.」

372:t_014:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I know! But I won't let them lay a finger on anyone in town!」

372:t_014:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Watch me, $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$! I'm never going to lose!!」

372:t_015:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right, we've won a complete victory!」

372:t_015:1.en:
$$葵$$
「By the way, what happened to $$ギルター$$?」

372:t_015:2.en:
$$くらら$$
「$$エコーズ$$ pursued him, but he got away.」

372:t_015:3.en:
$$葵$$
「As always, running away is the one thing he's good at.」

372:t_016:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$... You all look like you're doing well.」

372:t_016:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$勝平$$. You're the one who protected their smiles.」

372:t_016:5.en:
$$勝平$$
(Dad... What we've done... wasn't meaningless, was it...?)

372:t_016:6.en:
$$勝平$$
(That's why... I'll fight. Even when it's painful, even when I'm scared...)

372:t_017:0.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't here to help... I have to sharpen my own senses...!)

372:t_017:1.en:
$n
(Using no way as way, using no limitation as limitation...! I still haven't surpassed my limits!)

372:t_018:0.en:
$$木下$$
「Twenty-five enemies were destroyed in one minute! That was a dazzling performance!」

372:t_018:1.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Wonderful...! You're on a roll, like a bamboo stalk splitting!」

372:t_018:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Does that mean I've got momentum like a cow or a pig?」

372:t_018:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「President... He said a bamboo stalk, not livestock.」

372:t_018:4.en:
$$厚井$$
「It looks like you need some intensive study sessions...」

372:t_100:0.en:
$n
(Come to think of it, I originally piloted $$ジェニオン$$ alone...)

372:t_100:1.en:
$n
(I'll get stronger to bring Miss $$スズネ$$ back... And to do that, I'll get back to basics once more...!)

372:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
($$ガイゾック$$'s 《$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$》 said Earth's people weren't worth protecting...)

372:t_101:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(Like hell I'll listen to that thing! I'll protect them, no matter what...! Our planet and everyone who lives on it!)

372:t_102:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(You've grown stronger, $$勝平$$. I can't afford to fall behind either...!)

372:t_102:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(The sun is with me! If $$勝平$$ becomes the moon that lights the dark night, I'll become the sun!)

372:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Watching that boy $$香月$$ reminds me of $$トウジ$$...)

372:t_103:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
($$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$ are gone now... But I'll fight...)

372:t_103:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I want to fight to protect someone, just like $$勝平$$.)
